name: How can I prevent my window sills from rotting in the future?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent my window sills from rotting in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future rot, regularly inspect your window sills for cracks, peeling paint, or gaps in the caulk. Ensure proper drainage away from the windows and keep gutters clean. Apply a fresh coat of quality exterior paint or sealant every few years to protect the wood. Address any leaks or condensation issues promptly. Using rot-resistant materials like PVC or composite for replacement sills can also offer enhanced protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regularly inspect sills, maintain paint/sealant, ensure proper drainage, and promptly address leaks. Consider rot-resistant materials for replacements.
